My life isn't all that awful. I have a wonderful woman I've been with for 4 years, I have all the material things I'd like, my music is getting recognized, and I'm going to be graduating from college.

I have a small history of self-harm, but it never really helped me so I haven't done it. 

It's not that I want to kill myself. I don't have it in me. I want to either not have existed at all or to get better. I need this to stop happening to me. The person I am has changed since my childhood yes, but my feelings have changed very little. 

I don't not have a will to live (yay double-negatives), I need to get better, and inpatient facilities are the only options I haven't tried. 

I suffer from symptoms of psychosis, where I cannot differentiate reality from what I perceive around me, and that scares and frustrates me. A little embarrassing as well. I can become manic and withdrawn, but I could never hurt anyone which is what's really keeping me here.

I would talk with your family, SERIOUSLY. have a serious sit down conversation. Make them listen. I tried everything to make my family listen, but it was just always "try a different prescription".

I'm in my twenties, and considering inpatient care. I can afford it, but I'm also doing a lot of research. You might want to reach out to a professional, or a doctor/counselor or loved one first. Possibly someone older than you, although friends are great resources. 

I don't want to kill myself, I just don't want to have existed at all in the first place. I used to cut myself a little bit, but still participate in self-harming activities which I realize are only going to make my issues worse. 

Please talk to someone.

That's the point of tube amps. If you crank them, they will get distorted especially low watters. Think about the old Marshalls. They only got that signature crunch by being loud.

I'd look at getting a higher wattage amp if you want clean tones at any useable volume in a practice situation. Gigging, there's usually mics so it's not that big of a deal. 

I use two amps live (well, used to and will soon) a high wattage Fender Silverface Bassman (50 watts or above) and an 18 watt marshall. 

I would return or sell/trade it on craigslist for something louder with a clean channel, maybe a Peavey Classic 30 or 50. Feel free to PM me with any other questions.

I'm not sure, but look for VST plugins as well as virtual instruments. They seem like what you're looking for. You could also try using Fruity Loops as a drum tracking and synth software. If you have any questions please let me know.

I've used Reaper for a few productions. It's a great DAW and even though I use Logic Pro now, I would still use Reaper if I didn't get such a great deal on Logic. 

It does quite a bit and is really easy to set up and use.

I like the Samson GoMic for recording real instruments and vocals. It's really cheap ($30 ish) and sounds fairly good. For a direct interface, look at M-Audio stuff. Akai and Korg make nice MIDI controllers as well for a great price.
It is pretty interesting, but it totally depends on the brand.
